U_0x00B4DF: Lion's successor from <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>; 'Relion' = 'Refined Lion.' Human-type arms wield varied weapons like the Guarlion. A multirole <Armored Module>: stronger, easier to handle, maintain, and produce than the Lion.
U_0x00C042:
&A mass-production <Armored Module> Lion variant used by <DC> remnants. Officially 'Lion Type-C'; 'Cosmolion' is a nickname.
Built for space combat: a large booster with improved <Tesla Drive> boosts speed/range; a missile container sits on its back. With tuning and skill it can work under gravity.
U_0x00CFEE: <Earth Fed Army> tank w/ big railgun.
U_0x00D061: A space vessel used by <Earth Fed Army> and others. Its frame hull mounts weapon units (missiles, lasers), catapult containers for <Armored Module>s/<Personal Trooper>s, or cargo - serving as battleship, mothership, transport, or support ship.
U_0x00D259: A large space battleship used by <Earth Fed Army> and others, often a fleet flagship, with strong search and spacecraft control. Made of a battle carrier bearing space fighters and <Armored Module>s, plus five beam-cannon ships. These can act alone and evacuate crew to be used as missiles themselves.
U_0x00D478: A battle carrier used by <Shadow Mirror>. Its <Tesla Drive> gives great capacity/stealth; works in space, air, underwater. Rumored to counter Spacenoah carriers like Hagane.
U_0x00D634:
2nd Spacenoah-class all-purpose carrier, built vs. extraterrestrials. Floats via <Tesla Drive>, driven by 8 main rockets. Drag-resistant hull allows space, air, and underwater use. Strong anti-ship bombardment; carries <Personal Trooper>s and fighters, enabling "ISA" (Integrated Synchronizing Attack: mobile carrier + its humanoid weapons striking together).
Spacenoah class arose from two aims - escort ship for the Earth-evacuation fleet, and <PT> battle carrier vs. extraterrestrials - gaining combat power under the Earth Sphere Defense Concept despite the Evacuation Plan's aims. To hide this, it uses a modular design: hull/engines form a common core, with swappable combat modules at the bow. Ships 1-3 each carry a different module.
Hagane's bow module is the Tronium Buster Cannon, a high-output heavy-metal particle cannon giving top-class Federation firepower. Codename "Steel 2."
U_0x00DDA4: 3rd Spacenoah-class carrier, built vs. extraterrestrials. Floats via <Tesla Drive>, driven by 8 main rockets. Kurogane's bow module is a huge rotating ram for shattering bedrock (Excalibur Drill Ram), for anti-ship melee and clearing rock/ice. Raising <Tesla Drive> output forms the "Break Field," a ship-wide force field; with the ram, it breaks wide <Energy Field>s like those around enemy forts. Codename "Iron 3."
